avenues.name: The achievement ledger
avenues.thesis: A 271-row, event-anchored, per-row-verified corpus of US and Chinese achievements 1926–2026; 266 rows ESTABLISHED under a published promotion standard, with the full 1926–2025 chronological corpus now processed.

avenues.name: Coverage shape
avenues.thesis: Facts about the corpus under the published selection rule: US coverage is steady and invention/deployment-heavy; China's is thin early, rises late, and is completion/milestone-heavy. A statement about the ledger — NOT a momentum verdict about the world.

avenues.name: The momentum index
avenues.thesis: Designed, gated, and not run: no decade scores while the corpus still holds OPEN-UNVERIFIED rows. Rubric + sensitivity analysis committed as design only; the chart will be OPEN-CAVEATED when it exists, never higher.

avenues.name: Early-century China floor
avenues.thesis: 1926–1945 China coverage is a floor, not a fact — real historical thinness compounded by English-language source bias. Posted as an open challenge: readers who know this literature can raise it, for named credit.

avenues.name: Verification in progress
avenues.thesis: Live status: 266 ESTABLISHED, 4 OPEN-UNVERIFIED, 1 REPORTED. Batches 1–10 processed the full 1926–2025 chronological corpus; the 4 remaining OPEN rows are early stragglers held for a second independent source or a crisp anchor (the 2026 window is not yet closed).

checks._comment: Single source of truth for the consistency-check RULES. Both index.html's console and verification/verify_numbers.py read these, so a threshold can never drift between the page and the verifier. Change a rule HERE and both sides enforce it on next run. (The check LOGIC is still written in each language — see AUTHORING.md — but the rules it enforces live only here.)
